Subject: Lighthouse QBR prep — triage, renewal watch and asks for exec outreach

Team,

Quick synthesis ahead of the Lighthouse QBR (scheduled 2028-08-02): I pulled the latest usage trends, stability incidents, and CS health notes and I think this account needs prioritized attention for renewal. High-level:

- ARR: $1.2M (annualized) — renewal due 2028-09-15.
- Current health: Yellow -> trending toward red on three vectors: latency regressions for long-sequence jobs, two recent production failures (7/03 and 7/19) with escalations to eng on both, and a rising list of feature requests that touch private deployment (VPC) which they flagged as gating.
- Recent spend drop: 22% MoM on inference calls for mid-June to mid-July. Likely due to throttling from their infra team after the incident.

Risk register (short):
1) Technical continuity (Risk: HIGH) — Their platform runs heavy long-context pipelines; last two regressions caused 4h+ downtime for key batch jobs. Mitigation: canary rollout plus dedicated capacity recommendation, prioritize a hotfix for the root cause (KV cache leak). Owner: Marcus.
2) Compliance evidence (Risk: MED) — Procurement asked for SOC2 log retention and audit proof; they may pause renewal until we provide log export. Mitigation: compile SOC2 logs, provide a one-time retention extension. Owner: Mina.
3) Commercial pressure (Risk: MED) — They are asking for a credit for the downtime and a firm uptime SLA. Mitigation: propose a 10% credit + committed Dedicated pilot. Owner: Jordan.

Exec asks: we need an outreach plan to the CTO (Priya) and CRO (not on thread) to signal prioritization and offer a short leadership-level call during QBR week. I recommend Marcus or myself join with an engineering exec (VP Eng) and Jordan do the commercial touch.

Attachments: lighthouse-health-deck.pdf (working), qbr-agenda-draft.md (outline). HubSpot: DL-2028-047.

Please reply with one-line confirmations and any blockers by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Sooj
